subject: PO header & billing cadence — discount eligibility
messages:
From: Sara Holloway <sara.holloway@bluemarshhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluemarshhealth.com
Date: 2026-02-21T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: PO header & billing cadence — discount eligibility

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the proposal your team shared last week. Procurement at BlueMarsh is reviewing commercial terms and we have a couple of non-negotiable asks before we can issue a PO:

- PO header must include our full legal name and remit address (see below).
- Invoices must be issued on a monthly cadence and reference the PO number on each invoice line.
- Our standard net terms are Net45 — exceptions require CFO approval and an internal justification.

Separately, finance asked whether a committed usage discount can be tied to a quarterly minimum rather than an annual commitment (our Q1 budget is constrained). If Redwood can offer a tiered discount tied to quarterly committed spend, we can likely push approval faster.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether you can accept Net45 by default (or what lead time is needed for an exception).
2) If you can support monthly invoices that include the PO number on each line item.
3) Whether you can reframe the discount to a quarterly minimum (we're proposing $75k/Q).

Remit details for PO header:
BlueMarsh Health, Inc.
Attn: Accounts Payable
123 Harbor Lane
San Diego, CA 92101
EIN: 12-3456789

Thanks — looking to close procurement checklist this week.

Sara Holloway
Senior Procurement Manager
BlueMarsh Health

-----
Attachments: None

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holloway <sara.holloway@bluemarshhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-21T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO header & billing cadence — discount eligibility

Sara,

Appreciate the clarity — and great to see procurement moving quickly. Short answers up front:

1) Net45: We typically price assuming Net30, but we can accept Net45 on enterprise agreements; for this deal I'll request a Net45 default with finance. We may need a slight payment schedule (e.g., monthly invoices with a 15-day remittance window after receipt) for cash projection.

2) Monthly invoices with PO on each line: yes, we can format invoices to include PO number on every line. Our Billing team will need the exact PO field (PO number vs. PO reference) you use in your ERP.

3) Quarterly minimum discount: we can structure a quarterly committed spend slab. I need to confirm pricing bands with Marissa (CC'd). If BlueMarsh can commit ~$75k/Q as you suggested, we can offer a stepped discount: 7% for $50–74k/Q, 12% for 75–124k/Q, 18% for 125k+/Q.

I'll attach the updated pricing table and the revised SOW with the quarterly slab examples. Vanessa — can you confirm whether committing to Net45 introduces any approval delay on our side or if we should propose a commercial credit to offset the extended payment window?

Next steps: if Sara confirms the PO field name and the quarterly target, we'll generate a commercial summary and DocuSign packet.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-table.xlsx, SOW-v2.pdf

From: Sara Holloway <sara.holloway@bluemarshhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluemarshhealth.com
Date: 2026-02-22T08:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO header & billing cadence — discount eligibility

Thanks Vivek — that's helpful. A couple clarifications from our side:

- PO field: Our ERP expects a 10-digit PO number (numeric). Please put PO on each invoice line as "PO: ##########".
- Net45: we cannot shorten to Net30; CFO signoff required for any exception. Net45 is standard.
- Quarterly pledge: we can confirm $75k/Q for Q2 if the discount applies to consumption and is reconciled monthly (meaning each monthly invoice counts toward the quarterly minimum and refunds/credits applied at quarter-end if under-commit).

One more ask — our legal team wants to ensure invoice remittance instructions include our vendor code and that invoice lines preserve SKU-level detail for reconciliation.

If you can produce a commercial summary that maps the quarterly slab to monthly billing with a simple credit calc at quarter-end (i.e., if committed Q < actual Q then no credit; if actual < committed then prorated credit back to the customer), we can push to get procurement sign-off this week.

Sara

-----
On Feb 21, 2026, at 11:15 AM, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sara,
> 
> Appreciate the clarity — and great to see procurement moving quickly. Short answers up front: ...

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holloway <sara.holloway@bluemarshhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-23T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO header & billing cadence — discount eligibility

Sara,

See the commercial summary below — condensed for procurement review. Full line items are in the attached pricing-table.xlsx.

Commercial summary (proposal):
- Commitment: $75,000 per quarter (counts as monthly target: $25,000/mo).
- Billing cadence: Monthly invoices aligned to calendar month. Each invoice will include: PO: ##########, BlueMarsh vendor code (to be provided), SKU-level lines.
- Net terms: Net45. Redwood accepts Net45 under the enterprise agreement. To offset the longer payment period, Redwood requests a 2% commercial credit applied to the quarter if invoices are not paid within 60 days of issue (this is a precaution — we can negotiate wording).
- Discount slab (applied as credit at quarter-end if monthly totals meet slab):
  * $50k–$74,999/Q => 7% discount on consumption billed that quarter
  * $75k–$124,999/Q => 12% discount
  * $125k+/Q => 18% discount
- Reconciliation: Monthly invoices count toward the quarterly target. At quarter close we reconcile and issue a credit invoice if the committed threshold was met. Credits appear on the next invoice.

Attachments: pricing-table.xlsx (breaks down per-SKU pricing and shows example calc), SOW-v2.pdf (updated term showing Net45 and reconciliation language).

Vanessa — please confirm internally whether the 2% conditional credit is acceptable as consideration for Net45. Marissa — can you draft the short commercial addendum (1 page) that maps the slab to the DocuSign signature flow? I'll include a DocuSign link once the addendum is ready.

Vivek

-----
Attachments: pricing-table.xlsx, SOW-v2.pdf

From: Sara Holloway <sara.holloway@bluemarshhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluemarshhealth.com
Date: 2026-02-24T14:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO header & billing cadence — discount eligibility

Vivek,

This looks good and aligns with our procurement constraints. A few final items before we route to legal and AP:

- We accept the quarterly slab structure and the monthly reconciliation approach.
- Net45 is fine; legal asks to remove the 2% conditional credit language and instead include a late-payment interest clause at your discretion. We prefer no "credit" tied to payment timing.
- Please send invoices with the PO number formatted as "PO: ##########" and include our vendor code (we will send the code in a separate email).

If you can: 1) remove the 2% credit and replace with a standard late fee clause, and 2) produce the one-page addendum, we will issue a PO and route the DocuSign link to our signatory.

We'll expect the DocuSign packet referencing deal DW-8421. Procurement will issue PO # 0001842763 as soon as the addendum is attached.

Thanks — Sara
